detections.summary: Sponsor read for Nordlite electrolyte mix, describing its electrolyte content, sugar-free selling point, and host testimonial.

detections.evidence_quote: use the code pod20 for 20 percent off your first order
detections.summary: Sponsor read with a discount code and call to action.

detections.evidence_quote: i noticed i stopped getting that mid afternoon crash pretty much the first week
detections.summary: Host offers a personal testimonial that the product stopped his mid-afternoon crash.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Nordlite contains sodium, potassium, and magnesium in a ratio that is supposedly closer to what the body loses when you sweat.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: sodium potassium and magnesium in a ratio that's supposedly closer to what your body actually loses when you sweat
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable product composition claim about the electrolyte ratio in the advertised mix.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Nordlite has three times the electrolytes of a typical sports drink.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: it says right on the packet that it has three times the electrolytes of a typical sports drink
verification_candidates.rationale: A quantified product claim that can be checked against the product label or independent analysis.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Nordlite does not load it up with sugar like many other drink mixes on the shelf.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: they also don't load it up with sugar like a lot of the other drink mixes on the shelf
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable free-from claim about the product's sugar content relative to competitors.
